types_proposed.name: XAnimNode
types_proposed.evidence: childCount +0x0c, parentIndex +0x0e, tagged clip pointer +0x10, firstChild +0x12; fields overlap under stride 8 (see open questions)

open_questions: XAnimNode: the tagged clip pointer at +0x10 and firstChild at +0x12 overlap under the 8-byte record stride. The union reproduces the byte semantics as written; confirm whether the table is really interleaved or the stride is a decoding artefact (objdump of FUN_080c0d38 confirms [edx+eax*8+0xc]).
XAnimSlot fields +0x02 (unk02), +0x08 (unk08) and the second handle array of the tree are named only by their access pattern.

Out-of-chunk callee signatures (fn_080bde02, fn_080bdf80, fn_080bfc04, fn_080bf112, fn_080c3be4, fn_080c3cb0) are inferred from call sites only; the merge lane should check them against their own chunks.
Functions returning long double (XAnim_NodeDurationSec, XAnim_NodeTime, XAnim_Abs, XAnim_RSqrt, XAnim_Vec2LenSq, XAnim_Vec4LenSq) rely on x87 st(0) return; callers must convert identically.
XAnim_NodeDurationMs assumes FPU round-to-nearest for ROUND (rintl); not checked against the disassembly of FUN_080c0d6c.
XAnim_RSqrt reproduces the 0x5f3759df bit trick and one Newton step exactly as the disassembly shows (sar, fmul/fsub order); the constant 0x38000100 used for dequantisation is 1/32767.

Tree and binding names (XAnim_*) are descriptive: no string names the tree subsystem directly; the names follow the format strings "animation ... cannot be sync", "Cannot find xanim/%s" and "exceeded maximum number of anim info".
